summary: A loser's tone runs from gracious to bitter, set by who they are.
realLife: Five concessions are gracious or unifying; one blames the voters and the campaign and gives no congratulations.
sources: Eric Mitchell, Austin city council runoff loss, June 1997, text in the Austin Chronicle: https://www.austinchronicle.com/news/mitchells-speech-11735820/
Lori Lightfoot, Chicago mayor, concession, Feb 28, 2023: https://www.americanrhetoric.com/speeches/lorilightfootconcessionspeech.htm

inGame: personality-v1 facets on the person record (combative, proud, forgiving, humble) pull the tone

turns.way: A gracious loser is cut short by a hard night.
turns.pulledBy: a loss by a handful of votes

turns.way: A bitter loser softens at the end.
turns.pulledBy: a proud loser with family in the room
